name: Work Permit + Temporary Residence Permit -- Employment

requirements.blocker_text: The Ukrainian employer (not the foreign worker) must obtain a permit to employ the foreign national from a regional employment centre, including a draft employment contract compliant with Ukrainian labour law and proof the position does not require Ukrainian citizenship or state security clearance.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer willing to obtain the work permit.

requirements.blocker_text: Employers must generally pay the foreign employee at least 10 times Ukraine's statutory minimum wage; public organisations and educational institutions may instead pay at least 5 times the minimum wage.
D visa, Ukrainian translation of passport, and medical insurance for the temporary residence permit application.

evidence_required.document: Draft employment contract compliant with Ukrainian labour law
D visa, translated passport, medical insurance

outcome.duration_length: work permit up to 3 years by contract-length tier; temporary residence permit for the duration of the employment contract

sources.title: Diia (Ukraine's official government e-services portal) -- work permit for foreign employees: employer-only application, minimum-wage-multiple salary floor (10x standard / 5x public-sector), 7-working-day processing, validity tiers up to 3 years
State Migration Service of Ukraine -- Temporary Residence Permit: employment category, validity for the duration of the employment contract

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ukraine). The 10x-minimum-wage salary floor is a genuinely distinctive, easy-to-overlook constraint: it is far higher than most countries' work-visa salary thresholds in this dataset and independently blocks lower-paid roles regardless of other qualifications. work_rights is 'restricted' since the permit and residence status are tied to the specific employer and approved role. No distinct self-employed/freelance ('work_independent') residence category was found among Ukraine's 12 temporary-residence categories -- the closest is the investment category (ua_investor_residence.json, requiring a minimum EUR 100,000 stake in a Ukrainian legal entity), which is a genuine structural gap for an ordinary independent contractor or freelancer, disclosed here rather than force-fit.
